INCIDENT TYPE:
TRAINING DATA POISONING

DESCRIPTION:
Attackers manipulate datasets used to train AI systems, causing biased, malicious, or inaccurate model behavior.

THREAT FRAMEWORK:
- Emerging AI Threat

INDICATORS:
- Unexpected model outputs
- Dataset integrity violations
- Anomalous training behavior
- Poisoned training records

DETECTION RULES:
- Dataset anomalies
- Unexpected training metrics

AFFECTED ASSETS:
- Training datasets
- ML pipelines
- AI models
title: TRAINING DATA POISONING
